identity.rule: Every progress response must identify the logical process that produced it.

run_lifecycle.rule: A process chain must define the phases it can emit for every supported mode.

review_lifecycle.rule: Review mutations must either remove/update the current finding or resume from a persisted cursor.

resume.rule: After a review mutation, the next scan must continue after the last reviewed unit and must retain prior counters. After backend reopen with resumable stopped or unfinished progress, the UI must offer an explicit restart-or-resume choice at the owning view.

storage.rule: Saved findings and immediate review state must be distinguishable by mode and action.

stop_blocking_reconnect.rule: Every long-running scan must expose progress and stop routes; concurrent incompatible starts must report blocked; after terminal stopped progress a different operation may start without inheriting stale identity or stop flags.

delegated_reconnect_options.rule: When a process is started through one UI domain but owned by another backend operation, reconnect must adopt the backend action and restore the running options in the owning view.

slow_auxiliary_endpoints.rule: Slow or empty auxiliary endpoints such as findings or InsightFace status must not clear, replace, or hide a running process identity while progress still reports an active operation.
